neighbours.label: wording that frames a claim or its defender as partisan: 'purporting', 'purportedly', 'apologist'
fire: The lobby cites a report purporting to demonstrate the benefit.
The firm circulated a memo purporting to clear its directors.
The leaflet quotes a survey purporting to reveal a link.
An article purportedly proving the claim appeared online.
The institute released data purportedly confirming the effect.
He became an apologist for the dictator.
She was the chief apologist of the old regime.
The ad cites a trial purporting to establish the treatment.
quiet: The lobby cites a report describing the benefit.
The firm circulated a memo thanking its directors.
The leaflet quotes a survey about a link.
An article carefully reviewing the claim appeared online.
The institute released data summarizing the effect.
He became an adviser for the dictator.
She was the chief historian of the old regime.
The ad cites a trial evaluating the treatment.

notes: Weak pole (max 8.9), no single token on the card. 'so-called' and 'allegedly' stayed quiet in probes, so the label is narrow. The + pole is ' prove'.
